items.title: Is Alzheimer’s Data Altering The Investment Case For Biogen (BIIB)?
items.summary: Biogen recently shared new clinical, biomarker and safety data on its Alzheimer’s portfolio at the CTAD 2026 conference, including extended Phase 2 CELIA results for diranersen and long term analyses for lecanemab. The breadth of readouts, from 96 week diranersen extension data to real world lecanemab evidence, highlights how Alzheimer’s programs are shaping Biogen’s future treatment mix and operational focus. items.title: Biogen (BIIB) Stock Price Tracks Q3 Results Through Loss And Cash Flow
items.summary: Biogen shareholders woke up to a pullback. The stock closed at US$244.05, down 3.4% from the prior session, even though Q3 2026 revenue reached US$2.8b with double digit year on year growth and free cash flow hit US$600m. That gap between a weak price tape and an earnings print weighed down by a reported loss of US$20.6m is where your decision lives. The market is trading the headline loss.
